source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 266 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 266.

PD 266.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 266 was established by Ordinance No. 19503, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 25, 1987. Ordinance No. 19503 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 19503 was corrected by Ordinance No. 19561, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 27, 1987. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19503; 19561; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 266 is established on property generally located at the southeast corner of Dallas Parkway and Verde Valley Lane. The size of PD 266 is approximately 1.66 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Conceptual Site Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.104. CONCEPTUAL SITE PLAN.

Development of the Property must conform to the conceptual site plan (Exhibit 266A). (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Office Uses Defined
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.105. OFFICE USES DEFINED.

For the purposes of this article, reference to office uses includes office, medical clinic, and bank or savings and loan office uses unless otherwise stated. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.106. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A detailed development plan for the Property must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of a building permit for construction on the Property. The detailed development plan must substantially comply with the conceptual site plan. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.107. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are those uses permitted in an MO Mid-range Office District as set out in Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.108. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

A detailed landscape plan in conformance with Article X must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of a building permit for construction on the Property. The landscaping must be installed in accordance with the approved landscape plan within six months of the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any use on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Minimum Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.109. MINIMUM SETBACKS.

(a) Generally. Buildings and structures on the Property must be setback as follows:

(1) Twenty-five feet from the Dallas North Tollway.

(2) Ten feet from the southern boundary of the Property.

(3) Twenty-five feet from the eastern boundary of the Property.

(4) Thirty feet from the new right-of-way line of Verde Valley Lane, as indicated on the conceptual site plan.

(b) Special setback provision. If a building is erected or altered to exceed 36 feet in height, an additional setback from the eastern and southern boundary of the Property must be provided that is equal to one foot of additional setback for each foot of height for that portion of the building that exceeds 36 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 19561; 25711)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.110. COVERAGE.

Maximum permitted coverage, excluding parking structures, is 35 percent. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.111. FLOOR AREA.

Maximum permitted floor area on the Property is 104,862 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.112. HEIGHT.

Maximum permitted building height on the Property is 76 feet, except that a mechanical penthouse or parapet wall, when located on top of a building, may project a maximum of 12 feet above the permitted height. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.113. OFF-STREET PARKING.

In order to promote the development of transportation alternatives, the maximum number of parking spaces for office uses on the Property is restricted to 2.38 spaces for each 1,000 square feet of office development. For the purpose of this office parking limit, office use does not include medical clinic or bank or savings and loan uses. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Road Improvements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.114. ROAD IMPROVEMENTS.

(a) Mandatory dedications. The owner(s) must dedicate the following street rights-of-way within 90 days of receipt of notice from the director of public works and transportation or his designee that the city is preparing to begin paving operations, or prior to applying for a building permit for construction on the Property, whichever occurs first. A dedication fulfills the requirements of this subsection if it is an easement for street purposes or a greater estate in real property.

(1) Fifty feet from the centerline of Verde Valley Lane along the northern boundary of the Property.

(2) Ten feet along the western boundary of the Property for an additional lane on the northbound Dallas Parkway service road.

(b) Funding for on-site improvements. The owner(s) must fund all paving, drainage, and sidewalk improvement costs along the frontage of the Property for the following streets, when required by the director of public works and transportation as part of larger street improvement projects:

(1) Street widening along the south side of Verde Valley Lane.

(2) Street widening along the east side of Dallas Parkway. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Impact Fee Of Off-Site Improvements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.115. IMPACT FEE OF OFF-SITE IMPROVEMENTS.

(a) Generally. Prior to the issuance of the building permit for construction of a building for office use, the owner(s) must pay a fee of $.50 per square foot of office use for which a building permit is sought. This fee shall be adjusted annually, using 1986 as the base year, by the director of public works and transportation, to account for increases in the cost of eight-inch thick, 3000 psi, reinforced Portland cement concrete pavement. The fees collected under this article must be:

(1) placed in separate interest-bearing accounts in the Dallas Parkway Center Thoroughfare Improvements Fund; and

(2) used for off-site road improvements, as defined in the Dallas Parkway Center Study on file with the department of development services.

(b) Additional credits. If a person finances directly any off-site road construction within the area defined in the Dallas Parkway Center Study and if that financing has received prior written approval from the director of public works and transportation, that person shall receive a credit for those construction costs. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Refund Of Fee
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.116. REFUND OF FEE.

If, after a period of 10 years from the time of payment of a fee, any portion of the money has not been spent by transfer, allocation, or any other method, for the specified improvements, based on a first- in/first-out accounting method, the remaining portion of the fee paid shall be refunded to the payor or his assignee, with interest accrued at the city’s investment rate, less administrative costs, upon his application for refund, which must include proof of the amount and time of payment. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Replacement Of Fee
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.117. REPLACEMENT OF FEE.

If an area-wide road improvement fee is established by the city, that fee shall replace the fee established in this article, and the portion of any fees already paid under this article in excess of the area- wide fee will be credited toward future payments upon proof of overpayment. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.118. ACCESS.

Curb cuts for vehicular ingress and egress are limited to the number and approximate locations shown on the conceptual site plan. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.119. PAVING.

All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must comply with the requirements of Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.120. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Chapter 51, except that no non-premise signs are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Transportation Systems Management (Tsm)
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.121. TRANSPORTATION SYSTEMS MANAGEMENT (TSM).

(a) General. The owner(s) shall establish and operate a TSM program to encourage carpool, vanpool, transit, and other trip reduction alternatives consistent with the Parkway Center Report. A specific TSM action program must be submitted to the city plan commission concurrent with the submission of a detailed development plan. Subsequent to this submission, an annual report must be furnished to the director of public works and transportation.

(b) Reports. The first report must be submitted within two years after the issuance of the first certificate of occupancy on the Property and must be submitted annually thereafter until being directed otherwise by the director of public works and transportation. The final report must be submitted two years after the issuance of the certificate of occupancy which would permit occupancy of 90 percent of the buildings shown on the detailed development plan.

(c) Transportation Management Organization (TMO). In lieu of the above stated requirements, the owner(s) may participate in and fund, on a pro rata basis with other local area property owners, an area-wide TMO that is approved by the city. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Mandatory      Transportation                            Management
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.122. MANDATORY TRANSPORTATION MANAGEMENT ORGANIZATION (TMO) SUPPORT FEE.

(a) General. Prior to the issuance of the building permit for construction of a building for office use on the Property, the owner(s) must pay to the director of public works and transportation a fee of $.05 per square foot of office use for which a building permit is sought. The fees collected under this article must be:

(1) placed in separate interest bearing accounts in a special fund; and

(2) used for the establishment and operation of an area-wide TMO for the area described in the Dallas Parkway Center Study. The fee shall be adjusted annually, using 1986 as the base year, to reflect changes in service costs by using the Consumer Price Index for Urban Consumers (CPIU) for the Dallas/Fort Worth Standard Metropolitan Statistical Area.

(b) Refund. If, after a period of five years from the time of a payment of a TMO fee, at least 80 percent of the interest earned has not been spent by transfer, allocation, or any other method for TMO operations, based on a first-in/first-out accounting method, the fee paid shall be refunded to the payor or his assignee, together with any remaining interest accrued at the city's investment rate, upon his application for refund, which must include proof of the amount and time of payment. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.123. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Development of the Property must comply with all other requirements of all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-266.124. ZONING MAP.

PD 266 is located on Zoning Map Nos. C-6 and C-7. (Ord. Nos. 19503; 25711)
